title: Feature: Design-system updates from real projects
hero: UX patterns that two real projects added after the starter was written, checked against their code and proposed for the luismc-docs design-system starter.
lede: Decided on 5 Nov: all 35 proposals go in; the owner chose every recommended option (D1-D6). Work starts after DS189 and DSY99 merge. 9 changes are left out.
